_comment: FAQ 更新日志（人工维护）。按 date 倒序展示；speciesId 可选，用于链接到鸟种详情。日期格式 YYYY-MM-DD。

entries.titleZh: 珠颈斑鸠：一张让人不适的图已停用，补入新图
entries.titleEn: Spotted Dove: a disturbing photo retired and replaced
entries.bodyZh: 珠颈斑鸠原有一张图让人不适，已停用，并补入 1 张成鸟特写（CC BY-SA），占用从未用过的 image-6，老缓存不会看到旧图。其余 4 张合格图片保留，现在展示 5 张。首图随之更换（D1 同步），题库不再出这张图。
entries.bodyEn: One Spotted Dove photo was disturbing to look at. It is retired and replaced by an adult close-up (CC BY-SA) using the never-used key image-6, so old caches cannot show the retired image. The other four suitable photos are kept; five are shown now. The lead image changed accordingly (D1 synced) and the quiz bank no longer serves it.

entries.titleZh: 三宝鸟：图一其实是红嘴蓝鹊，已停用并换题
entries.titleEn: Dollarbird: the first photo was actually a Red-billed Blue Magpie — retired and replaced
entries.bodyZh: 图一（iNaturalist 照片 238508830）画面主体是红嘴蓝鹊，不是三宝鸟——它恰是 iNat 上三宝鸟的物种默认图，其观察只有这一张照片却被社区标到 research grade，源站标注本身就错了。该图已停用，补入 1 张北京国家植物园的照片（obs 221758152，CC BY-NC），占用从未用过的 image-6，老缓存不会看到旧图。原 2/3/4/5 复核无误予以保留，现在展示 6/2/3/4/5 共 5 张。首图随之更换（D1 同步），题库不再出这张错图。
entries.bodyEn: The subject of photo 1 (iNaturalist photo 238508830) is a Red-billed Blue Magpie, not a Dollarbird. It happens to be iNaturalist's default photo for the Dollarbird taxon, and its observation — which contains only that one photo — was voted to research grade, so the source annotation itself was wrong. The photo is retired and one new photo is added (obs 221758152, Beijing Botanical Garden, CC BY-NC), using the never-used key image-6 so old caches cannot show the retired image. Originals 2/3/4/5 were re-checked and kept; the gallery now shows 6/2/3/4/5 (5 in total). The lead image changed accordingly (D1 synced) and the quiz bank no longer serves the wrong photo.

entries.titleZh: 绿头鸭：四张不适合作答的图已停用，补入四张成鸟图
entries.titleEn: Mallard: four unsuitable photos retired, four adult photos added
entries.bodyZh: 图 2 是家鸭的凤头品种（头顶毛冠）；图 3 是无法定种的小鸭；图 4 是白色家鸭；图 5 是雌鸟背光在喂食器上、主体难辨——四张均已停用。保留原图 1（雄雌并肩、标准侧身），新增四张：雄鸟水面近照、雄鸟雪地、雌鸟飞行、双雄争偶，占用 image-6/7/8/9，老缓存不会看到旧图。首图随之更换，题库同步更新。
entries.bodyEn: Photo 2 was a crested domestic duck (tuft on the head); photo 3 a brood of ducklings that cannot be confirmed as Mallard; photo 4 a white domestic duck; photo 5 a backlit female on a feeder with an unrecognisable subject. All four are retired. Original 1 (male and female side by side, standard profile) is kept, and four new photos are added: male close-up on water, male on snow, female in flight, two males competing. They occupy image-6/7/8/9, so old caches will not show the retired images. The lead photo has changed and the quiz bank follows.

entries.titleZh: 赭红尾鸲：脚环特写与白化个体两张图已停用，补入雄/雌各一张
entries.titleEn: Black Redstart: band close-up and leucistic bird retired, one male and one female added
entries.bodyZh: 图 1 是鸟环在手指间的特写（环志记录，画面里没有鸟），图 2 是近全白的白化个体且为 ND 许可；两张均已停用。保留 3/4/5，新增雄鸟（obs 339875349）与雌鸟（obs 189450325），写入未使用过的 image-6/7，老缓存不会看到旧图。首图随之更换，题库同步更新。
entries.bodyEn: Photo 1 was a close-up of a leg ring held in a hand (a ringing record with no bird), photo 2 an almost all-white leucistic individual under an ND licence; both are retired. Photos 3/4/5 kept, with a male (obs 339875349) and a female (obs 189450325) added in unused slots image-6/7 so cached clients never show the old files. The first image changed and the quiz bank was updated accordingly.

entries.titleZh: 黄腹鹨：远景小图与两张低清图已停用，补入 3 张高清图
entries.titleEn: Buff-bellied Pipit: distant/low-res photos retired, three high-resolution photos added
entries.bodyZh: 图 3 中鸟只占几十像素；复核时发现图 1（403×322，且是首图）严重模糊、图 2（517×322）也低于 1200px 门槛。三张均已停用，保留 4/5，新增 obs 142270736 / 409498438 / 35359139（长边均 ≥1260px）到 image-6/7/8。首图换为清晰成鸟照，题库同步更新。
entries.bodyEn: In photo 3 the bird is only a few dozen pixels wide; review also found photo 1 (403×322, and the quiz image) badly blurred and photo 2 (517×322) below our 1200px bar. All three retired; photos 4/5 kept; obs 142270736 / 409498438 / 35359139 (all ≥1260px on the long edge) added as image-6/7/8. The first image is now a sharp adult, and the quiz bank was updated.

entries.titleZh: 白骨顶旧图已从画廊移除，并补入第 5 张；答疑改为「已修复」说明
entries.titleEn: Coot: old photo removed, a fifth photo added; note rewritten as a fixed-issue history
entries.bodyZh: 此前那张「雀鹰扑抓白骨顶」的照片只是不再是首图，仍排在画廊第 2 位；现已从素材列表移除，并补入 1 张清晰的白骨顶亲鸟带雏（obs 17125901），恢复为 5 图。答疑不再用「为什么首图看起来不对」的疑问式标题，改为说明来龙去脉与修复结果。
entries.bodyEn: The sparrowhawk-grabbing-a-coot photo had only stopped being the first image; it was still in slot 2 of the gallery. It has now been removed and a clear photo of an adult with chicks (obs 17125901) has been added, restoring the gallery to 5 photos. The note no longer asks “why does the first photo look wrong?” and instead explains what happened and what was fixed.

entries.titleZh: 喜鹊图片更换：停用 3 张、新增 3 张
entries.titleEn: Oriental Magpie photos replaced: 3 retired, 3 added
entries.bodyZh: 有反馈指出喜鹊第 1/3/5 张图不适合识别（不像喜鹊 / 模糊 / 羽色异常）。已停用这三张，补入 3 张新图（iNaturalist，CC0 / CC BY-NC）；现在保留原第 2、4 张 + 新第 6、7、8 张。详见物种答疑。
entries.bodyEn: A report noted that photos #1/#3/#5 of the Oriental Magpie were unsuitable (not a magpie / blurry / atypical plumage). They are retired and replaced with 3 new photos (iNaturalist, CC0 / CC BY-NC); the gallery now keeps original #2 and #4 plus new #6, #7 and #8. See the species note for details.

entries.titleZh: 白骨顶首图已改为策展默认图
entries.titleEn: Coot main photo now uses the curated default
entries.bodyZh: 有反馈指出白骨顶的首图里主体其实是雀鹰。已改为优先使用物种策展默认图（default_photo），并加入人工覆盖表兜底；旧图仍保留在下方其它素材中供对照。
entries.bodyEn: A report noted the coot's main photo actually features a sparrowhawk. We now prefer the species' curated default photo (default_photo) with a manual override fallback; the old photo remains in the gallery for comparison.

entries.titleZh: 新增「大众评审」：反馈可上传并投票
entries.titleEn: Community review: reports can be uploaded and voted
entries.bodyZh: 题目页新增「报错」按钮：可选图片/录音/答案问题并填写你认为的正确答案。反馈会先在本地保存，联网后上传；在「大众评审」页大家可以投票，帮助我们判断并纠正。
entries.bodyEn: A new Report button on quiz questions lets you flag photo/recording/answer issues and suggest the correct answer. Reports are saved locally first, uploaded when online, and everyone can vote on the Review page to help us verify and fix them.
